product_one_liner.value: Mimica uses AI to observe how teams work, map their end-to-end business processes, and create AI agents to automate them for enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer exposes no pricing page; its public site instead directs prospects to contact Mimica for information. Third-party listings describe custom/quote pricing, not a Mimica pricing page.

named_customers.notes: All listed names appear in Mimica case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company page reports 201–500 employees; it provides an estimated employee count, not an exact roster.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies London, England as headquarters; company address is 107 Cheapside, London.

founded_year.notes: Mimica's about page says it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The readable resources/articles index shows marketing, product and company announcements; no two technical posts about product engineering or infrastructure were found.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer shows no public documentation, help center or developer portal link. The site has resources such as guides, but not a public product docs/help portal meeting the criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers page links to Ashby open positions, but retrieved job-board content did not reveal current role titles. Search results show an ML engineering role, but no live posting was verified in a page that could support a current status.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public privacy policy and product/company materials; they do not name the AI model or model provider. The privacy page does not name subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: Company homepage explicitly claims ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance. GDPR is a regulation rather than a certification and is not included in this certification list.

last_funding.notes: Mimica announced a $26.2 million Series B on September 24, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series B falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: There are live job listings linked from the careers page, but the job-board titles were not retrievable in the visited page output, so it could not be verified whether SDR/BDR/AE roles are open.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica announced Mimica Analyst on August 31, 2026 and Mimica Maker on September 30, 2026; both are within six months of the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available about page identifies founders and current leadership, but there is no verifiable full team page or dated profile/announcement establishing whether a C-level or VP joined or left during the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Mimica job posting says the role will maintain pipeline activity and records in Salesforce.
